changelog: New in every chat menu: Media, links and docs - all photos, videos, documents and links of a chat in one place
Open a document straight from the list, or tap Show in chat to jump to its message
Send a chatbot from any chat: tap the paperclip, then Chatbot - and stop it from the chat at any time
Photos, videos and documents now open a preview first, with a caption for each file
Draw, highlight, add text, boxes and arrows, or crop and rotate a photo before you send it
Pick up to 20 photos and videos at once from the gallery
